messages:
maya: Hey team  quick: I'm on Redwood PPO Gold and traveling for work. I scheduled a virtual follow-up with my specialist but the clinic says they can't verify my coverage because my ID card shows my old address. Is a digital screenshot enough?

sam_people_ops: Screenshot is usually fine for telehealth. Providers mainly need member name, ID number, and plan. Do you have the member ID last4?

maya: Last4 6678. I pulled a screenshot but the address is old (moved last month)  I updated it in Workday but not sure when insurer syncs.

olivia-benefits: We can generate an expedited verification letter that shows active coverage and effective dates. Provider will accept that for telehealth check-in. Want me to create one and DM you?

maya: Yes please, appointment at 3pm PT.

insurance-bot: Support case ACME-VER-202605-881 created: request expedited eligibility verification for member last4 6678.

clinic-support: Hi Maya  Clinic can accept a digital ID + eligibility call to Acme Provider Services if you prefer. If benefits team can send a short POC note that speeds it.

olivia-benefits: Drafting POC now  will include plan name, member name/last4, effective date, and a contact line for Acme to confirm. Uploading in 10 minutes.

sam_people_ops: Note for tracker: "Traveling employee, outdated address on insurer record; expedited POC issued; provider verification recommended."

insurance-bot: ACME-VER-202605-881 updated: insurer confirmed eligibility for telehealth at in-network rates for scheduled date.

olivia-benefits: Uploaded POC PDF and emailed Maya. Link: https://files.redwood.internal/poc/maya-6678-202605.pdf

maya: Got it, clinic accepted screenshot + POC and did an eligibility call. Appointment went fine. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
